parameters.name: application

parameters.description:

parameters.name: environment

parameters.description:

parameters.name: insurerProject

parameters.name: setting

parameters.description: Value of the setting you are searching for. Not recommend for use with secrets, the search will be comparing the hashed value for the secret instead of the secret itself. Supports exact match only and requires the 'setting' parameter.
parameters.name: setting-value

parameters.description: The specific layer type to search for: [deployment, environment_level, insurer_project, project_planet_class, tenant_default]. **Tips:** - When searching by layer-type `deployment`, include a `deploymentId` to narrow results to a single **Deployment**. - When searching by layer-type `environment_level`, include an `environment` to narrow results to a single **Orbit**. - When searching by layer-type `insurer_project`, include a `insurerProject` to narrow results to a single **Star**. - When searching by layer-type `project_planet_class`, include `insurerProject` and `environment` to narrow results to a single **Star + Orbit**.
parameters.name: layer-type

parameters.description:
GRN of deployment - exact match only.

Supports searching by multiple comma-separated deployment IDs. Deployment IDs must belong to a single application. The general format of the deploymentId is {grn}:{version}:{app}:{insurer-code}:{insurer-project}:{supercluster}:{quadrant}:{planet-class}:{planet}:{resource_id}

post.description: Creates groups in Guidewire Hub for the given __applicationGroup__ and __role__. This endpoint will create and safelist a group per insurer project (including the special ‘all’ project) and planet-class category. Examples: _acme.lower.gwcp.all.helios.ig-user_, _acme.prod.all.all.helios.ig-user_, ... Security - caller must be an application group owner or a global admin.

conflictResolutionStrategy.description:
A conflict occurs when a different setting value for given setting being cloned already exists for the given destination.
When this occurs, the conflictResolutionStrategy tells Helios how to handle the conflict (i.e. return an error, skip / ignore, or override).
In the event that the source and destination values are equal there's no conflict, and Helios performs no action on the given setting.

Allowed Values:
* `fail_on_conflict` nothing gets copied and the request terminates with a 400 response whenever a conflict exists.
* `skip_conflicts` clones only the setting values that do not already exist in the destination and skips any conflicts (maintaining any pre-existing setting values).
* `override_conflicts` will clone all setting values to the destination by replacing any pre-existing setting values.

Application.description: An application in Helios represents a real application that is configured through Helios.

name.description: Name used to identify the application. This must be an exact match to the application name configured in the deployment id of the application. Note: The requirement for the name to match the deployent id does not apply to shared applications.

displayName.description: Displayable name for the application. Defaults to the value in the name field. Accepts Foreign Languages, such as: Arabic, Chinese, Kanji, ... May be null but does not accept an empty string or all whitespace

owner.description: The person or group that owns the application. This information is only used as contact information. It has no impact on security.

ownerEmail.description: Email address for the owner of the application. This information is only used as contact information. It has no impact on security.

isPublic.description: Indicates that the application is a public application (SPA) and does not require authentication. This type of application is not allowed to store secrets.

isCustomerDeveloped.description:
Indicates if the application is developed exclusively by a customer. 
When set to true, the application and all associated metadata is specific to a single tenant. 
This attribute may only be set when the application is initially created.

Note: Customer developed application names are required to start with one of the following prefixes: 
* 'bf' - BusinessFunctions applications
* 'ee' - EnterpriseEngage applications
* 'ig' - IntegrationGateway applications

isShared.description: Indicates that the application is responsible for publishing shared settings. Only applications with this flag enabled are permitted to share setting values with other applications. This attribute may only be set when the application is initially created.

applicationGroup.description:
Identifies the group of applications. 

Allowed application groups:
* 'ig' - IntegrationGateway applications (customer-developed)

Deprecated on 2024-02-26 - use applicationGroupExtensible instead.

applicationGroupExtensible.description:
Identifies the group of applications. 

Allowed application groups:
* 'bf' - BusinessFunctions applications (customer-developed)
* 'ee' - EnterpriseEngage applications (customer-developed)
* 'ig' - IntegrationGateway applications (customer-developed)
* 'is' - InsuranceSuite applications (bc, cc, cm, pc)

role.description:
For integration gateway applications, a single role named __user__ will be available.
The __user__ role will grant read access to all setting definitions, setting values and application records within the application group based on tenant access.

GwHubInstance.description: Name of the GW Hub instance where the client is registered.

SettingDefinitionResponse.description: Describes a setting for a given application.

settingName.description: Name of the setting this definition is associated with

isSecret.description:
If true, the associated setting is considered a secret. Defaults to 'true' when a `SecretType` is provided. When `isSecret` is explicitly set to `true` and `secretType` is not provided, the `secretType` will default to 'GENERIC'. If `secretType` is explicitly specified, it will take precedence over this default behavior.

Update restrictions apply to this field:

  • This flag cannot be updated when the definition is associated with a setting.

insurerProject.description: When this attribute is provided, a project-specific setting definition will be created for the tenant specified in the GW-Request-GRN header. <p/> Note : This attribute may only be set on create request.

settingDescription.description: A description of the setting that this definition is associated with

isTenantSpecific.description: Whether this setting is present only for the current tenant, i.e. hidden from other tenants.

isGuidewireManaged.description:
When set to true, corresponding setting value(s) can only be maintained by Guidewire.

Cannot create a definition as guidewire-managed when a less specific definition (one sharing the same application and setting name) already exists.            
Cannot change a definition to guidewire-managed when a more specific definition (one sharing the same application and setting name) already exists.

associatedTenants.description:
Shows all associated tenants having a setting value associated to this definition.
  • Only set on endpoint /applications/{applicationId}/setting-definitions/{settingDefinitionId}
  • Only set for Guidewire employees when authenticated through corp okta
  • Only set when the user token has tenant_id claim set to 'guidewire'

permittedSubscribers.description: List of applications permitted to subscribe to this setting

name.description: The name used to identify the role.

applicationId.description: The application to which the role applies

RoleMapping.description: Used to map a user identifier (email) or group identifier (group name) from the IdP to roles defined in the property service configuration.

emailAddress.description: The email address of the user assigned to the given role.

groupName.description: The name of the group assigned to the given role.

isTenantSpecific.description: Indicates if the role mapping is specific to the current tenant.

role.description: The name of the role granted to the user or group

applicationGroup.description: The name of the application group this role was granted for

isTenantSpecific.description: Indicates if the role mapping is specific to the current tenant.

ApplicationScope.description: Maps an application role to a scope

roleName.description: Name of the role to grant. This will be used to generate the scope name, <p/> Valid values: read, write, write-nonprod, definition-mgr, owner

RoleMappingCreateRequest.description: Used to map a user to a role.EmailAddress and groupName are mutually exclusive.

emailAddress.description: The email address of the user assigned to the given role.

groupName.description: The group assigned to the given role.

idpId.description: IdP ID registered in gwhub instance.

entityName.description: Name of the setting or application

tenantId.description: Identifies the tenant associated with the request

authorities.description: The authorities given to the user

environmentLevel.description: The environment level of the deployment - this has the same allowable values as planet class

supercluster.description: Geographical region - centaurus, copeland, pandora, etc

galaxy.description: GWCP name for an AWS region (andromedia, butterfly, needle, etc)

planetClass.description: Planet class - dev, staging, int, prod, etc

lastClientRequest.description:
Date/Time that configuration was requested for this deployment by a client. 
For deployments that make frequent requests (or when frequent requests occur),  this value may not reflect the time of the actual last request but a time close to the last request (i.e. within 15 minutes).  The limited accuracy is intended to avoid requiring frequent database writes when frequent reads occur.

useGrnCriteriaFormat.description: Used to track status of internal status GRN migration. This field is only temporary and will be removed in a future release without notice. Please ignore it. Only users with admin rights can update this flag.

allowDeprecatedLookup.description: Used to track status of internal status GRN migration. This field is only temporary and will be removed in a future release without notice. Please ignore it. Only users with admin rights can update this flag.

normalizedOn.description: Date/time on which the normalized deployment id was added or verified

subscriberApplicationId.description: Application ID of the subscribed setting

subscriberSettingDefinitionId.description: Setting definition ID of the subscribed setting

problems.description: Describes any issues that will prevent the subscription from being created.

overwriteSubscriberValuesCode.description: Required value of the overwriteSubscriberValues parameter needed to overwrite the subscriber values. Only populated when attempting to create a new subscription with the `dryRun` parameter set to true.

changesToApplyToSubscriber.description: Changes that will be applied to the subscriber if the overwriteSubscriberValuesCode is supplied.

SubscriberChangeSet.description: Changes to apply to the subscriber for a single tenant

create.description: Setting values to be created for the subscriber

update.description: Setting values to be updated for the subscriber

delete.description: Setting values to be deleted for the subscriber

idps.description: List of IdPs in which the groups were whitelisted.

applicationName.description: The name of the publisher's application

settingDefinitionId.description: The id of the publisher's setting definition

settingDefinitionName.description: The name of the publisher's setting definition

subscribedOn.description: The date the subscription was created on

subscribedBy.description: The user that created the subscription
